snippet.title: Homestar Runner Distraction Pack - Coming June 25, 2026!
snippet.description:
Everybody! Everybody! It’s just like, one minute, you’re thinking about miniature golf…and the next minute, you ARE miniature golf!

The Homestar Runner Distraction Pack arrives in Walkabout on June 25th, 2026!
